title: FLORA onboarding glow: neon-green highlight ring on the project panel
note: Lydia: I like this onboarding glow. From flora.ai. Step 3 of 4 in FLORA's product tour. The project switcher panel gets a soft neon-green outer glow and thin green stroke on a dark dotted canvas, instead of a dimmed overlay or spotlight cutout, and a mint-green tooltip card (dark green Next button, Back link, 3 of 4 counter) sits beside it. The glow color matches the tooltip, so the highlight and the explanation read as one unit.
